column1: # T23e: MAIN names for the most-called FUN_ functions (ranked by tools/naming_worklist.py main). address<TAB>name<TAB>comment
# Evidence: decomp/main as committed (2026-10-29) and the docs/code/main pages; ROM texts/tables read from build/FT-710_MAIN_V0112.bin where a comment says ROM.
# "UI +0xNN" = state block 0x20B04 + 0xNN (docs/code/main/README.md); screen flags from docs/code/main/display-link.md:
# +0x86 dialog, +0x88/+0x90 keyboard, +0x93 PlayList, +0x94 message screen, +0x95 menu, +0x96 FUNC panel, +0x97 memory list, +0x1C1/+0x1C2 pop-up shown/code.

column3: Sets bit (v & 7) of ICU IER[v >> 3] (0x87200 + v/8) for vector v [fact]; Renesas BSP R_BSP_InterruptRequestEnable [inference for the name] (T23a)
Clears bit (v & 7) of ICU IER[v >> 3] (0x87200 + v/8) for vector v [fact]; Renesas BSP R_BSP_InterruptRequestDisable [inference for the name] (T23a)
lowsrc charput: waits for DBG_DBGSTAT (0x840C0) bit 8 clear, writes DBG_C2E0 (0x84080) [fact]; E1/E2 virtual console, called by write [inference] (T23a)
lowsrc charget: waits for DBG_DBGSTAT (0x840C0) bit 12, returns DBG_E2C0 (0x84090) & 0xFF [fact]; E1/E2 virtual console [inference] (T23a)

(unit 0/1, cmd 0..12, arg): switch over the bsp_swint_* helpers; unit 0 = SWINT (vector 27), 1 = SWINT2 (vector 26); 3 = bad unit, 5 = bad cmd [fact]; the Renesas BSP software-interrupt API with the same command order [inference]
cmd 0: IPR (0x87303) & 0xF, IER bit, IR (0x8701A/B) bit and the nested flag 0x1432/3 into arg[0..3] [fact]
cmd 1: R_BSP_InterruptRequestEnable(0x1B unit 0 / 0x1A unit 1) [fact]
cmd 2: R_BSP_InterruptRequestDisable(0x1B / 0x1A) [fact]
cmd 3: priority < 16 written to the IPR with the IER bit saved and cleared around it [fact]
cmd 4: ICU SWINTR / SWINT2R (0x872E0 / 0x872E1) |= 1 [fact]
cmd 6: nested flag 0x1432[unit] = 1 [fact]
cmd 7: nested flag 0x1432[unit] = 0 [fact]
cmd 8: removes one of the 9 task slots (0x20318 + 0xC*i + 0x6C*unit) unless it is running (status 2) [fact]
cmd 9: resets all 9 slots to a dummy task and the queue counters 0x142C/0x142E/0x1430 [fact]
cmd 10: copies the 9 {status, function, argument} slots to arg [fact]
Exchanges the access word 0x20310[unit] with *arg; true when the lock was free (1) [fact]
Exchanges back into 0x20310[unit]; true when it now holds 1 [fact]
Runs the queued tasks of a unit in ring order (status 1 -> 2 -> fn(arg)), optional nesting via FUN_fff8fd84 [fact]; called from the SWINT ISRs [inference]
(unit, fn, arg, ...): queues fn in the next of 8 slots (counters 0x142C/0x142E) under the access lock; 6 = no function [fact]
Packed BCD byte -> binary: ROM table 0xFFF880C2 (0, 10, .., 90 at stride 2)[high nibble] + low nibble [fact]
(v, buf): u8 as 1..3 ASCII digits without leading zeros; returns the length [fact]
(v, buf): u16 as 1..5 ASCII digits without leading zeros; returns the length [fact]
(v, maxdigits 2..4, buf): decimal without leading zeros, returns the length; used by the DISPLAY-link frame builders [fact]
CAT AI EX reply value at 0x1B23D: u8 as 2 (arg 0) or 3 (arg 1) digits, or signed +/- 2 digits (3rd arg 0), then ';'; returns the reply length that the ai_ex* detectors store to 0x1FF12 [fact]
CAT AI EX reply value at 0x1B23D: u16 as 4 digits + ';'; returns the reply length [fact]

UI +0x97 = 0 (MEMORY CH LIST, frame 0x41) and +0x90 = 0 [fact]
UI +0x415 = 0 (dial x4, ui-keys.md) and +0x423 = 0 [fact]; purpose of +0x423 [unknown]
menu_close_if_open, func_panel_close, popup8_close, ui_clear_415_423, +0x70 = 0; stops a running scan (+0x418) and sets +0x409; returns false if it stopped a scan [fact]
UI +0x43C = 0, +0x409 = 1 (key consumed), beep_request(3) (error beep) [fact]
UI +0x86 = 1 (frame 0x70 due), selected button +0xBD = 0, clears +0x70 [fact]

Dialog n = 3 (ROM text "NO SD CARD"), +0x448 = 0, dialog_open [fact]

HCUT FREQ stepper: 1..67 and 0 = OFF above the top (menu.md) [fact]

AGC FAST/MID/SLOW DELAY row: raw*20+20 in decimal + "msec", bit 7 on the default [fact]
USB / REAR OUT LEVEL row: value via dec_to_str_u8 [fact]
LCUT FREQ row: OFF or the frequency (dec_to_str_u16) [fact]
LCUT SLOPE row: 6dB/oct / 18dB/oct (ROM 0xFFF836EB) [fact]
HCUT FREQ row: OFF or the frequency [fact]
HCUT SLOPE row: 6dB/oct / 18dB/oct [fact]
RPTT SELECT / PC KEYING row: OFF / RTS / DTR / DAKY (ROM 0xFFF83850) [fact]
OFF / ON row (ROM 0xFFF842E5): CW INDICATOR, SCU-LAN10, EMERGENCY FREQ TX, TX INHIBIT, EXT DISPLAY [fact]
CW MEMORY 1..5 row: TEXT / MESSAGE (ROM 0xFFF8444A) [fact]
MIC P1..P4 / UP / DOWN row: LOCK, QMB, .., AGC (21 labels, ROM 0xFFF84753) [fact]
PRMTRC EQ1..3 FREQ row (also the P PRMTRC items) [fact]

PRMTRC EQ1..3 BWTH row [fact]
Action rows (SD CARD, CALIBRATION, RESET, CERTIFICATION): width 4, text "DONE" [fact]
PRESET1..5 PRESET NAME row (12 chars at 0x9B2E + 0x1F*(n-1)) [fact]
PRESET n CAT-1 RATE row: 4800..115200bps (ROM 0xFFF8455B) [fact]
PRESET n CAT-1 TIME OUT TIMER row: 10/100/1000/3000msec (ROM 0xFFF845C4) [fact]
PRESET n CAT-1 CAT-3 STOP BIT row [fact]
PRESET n AGC FAST DELAY row [fact]
PRESET n AGC MID DELAY row [fact]
PRESET n AGC SLOW DELAY row [fact]
PRESET n LCUT FREQ row: OFF / 100Hz / 150Hz .. (ROM 0xFFF8509B) [fact]

dialog_no_sd_card, then sd_step_reset [fact]

CONTEST NUMBER (EX020205) as u16 BE from 0x9AAB / 0x9AAC [fact]

Pointer to the active mode's AESS on/off byte (0x9C10..) [fact] (#157, CAT AS)

R_SCI2_Serial_Send(buf, n), FUN_fffb192d(result), 0xA0AA = 1 [fact]
